name: New Constructor's Network Co., Ltd.
summary: New Constructor's Network Co., Ltd. engage sin the earthquake-resistant wooden design business in Japan. It is involved in the housing field network development; housing field House manufacturer correspondence; and non-residential large-scale wooden building fields activities. The company also offers construction method for wooden buildings; thermal energy calculation and agency services; housing loan; and BIM solutions. New Constructor's Network Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.
